title: fix(runtime)!: package commit revert and rollback act only on a commit of the package their path names
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X6hv78CUTUGu8UPTqHyYRaS)_

Fixes #28987

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/**` or `content/docs` says which package a commit revert or rollback acts on; `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx` only lists the door names.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`POST /packages/:id/commits/:commitId/revert` 和 `POST /packages/:id/rollback` 现在只处理路径里那个包自己的提交。提交属于别的包 → `404 COMMIT_NOT_FOUND`("No commit 'X' in package 'B'."),什么都不写;路径里的包不存在(含已卸载) → `404 Package 'X' not found`,与兄弟门一致。
- 为什么改:原来两个门都不读 `:id`。按包回滚的管理员一旦把提交号串错包,就会悄悄回滚另一个包的元数据(创建的被软删、编辑的被还原),回 200,还往那个包的历史里写一条 revert 提交,即使那个包已卸载。
- 风险与回滚:同包的提交照旧回滚,响应体不变;鉴权(manage_metadata)、围墙目录、查询参数三道拒绝的顺序不变。只读包(代码包/安装包)不加只读守卫:实测它们唯一的提交是环境覆盖(ADR-0131 D6)发布,撤销覆盖仍可用,已钉为对照。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 的 `readRevertableCommit`(新增的包比对);`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 两个门把 `packageId` 交给协议、未知包 404;`packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts`(需先建闭包),预期 7/7 通过;在 main 上其中 3 例为红。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`.** `revertCommit` and `rollbackToPackageCommit` take an optional `packageId`. `readRevertableCommit`, the one commit read both use, refuses a commit whose `package_id` is not that package with the existing `COMMIT_NOT_FOUND` (404), worded `No commit 'ID' in package 'PKG'.`, before the legacy-organization check and before anything is written. A caller that sends no `packageId` reads any commit, as before. This optional member is a widening of two published method signatures, beside the door narrowing: hence `yes (narrowing)`.
- **`@objectstack/runtime`.** Both doors read `:id` and hand it to the protocol as `packageId`. An unknown `:id` (`packageIsUnknown`, the predicate the draft doors and `GET /:id/commits` use) answers `404 Package 'ID' not found` without calling the protocol. The check sits inside each door's capability probe, so a partial protocol host still answers 501, and the rollback's `400 Body { commitId } is required` still comes first. `manage_metadata`, the walled-catalog refusal and the closed query set keep their order ahead of it.
- **No read-only guard (seat's ruling, option A).** The order asked for `requireWritablePackage` on both doors. Measured on main: a read-only package carries commits. An environment overlay draft on `showcase_task.default` bound to `com.example.showcase` (a booted code package), published with `publish-drafts`, records an `apply` commit in the showcase's history, and reverting it through the showcase's own path answers 200 and removes the overlay. Those are the only commits a read-only package can carry (`POST /packages/:id/publish` already refuses read-only packages). The sibling `POST /packages/:id/revert` answers a read-only package's stored rows before its own guard, so the guard there never refuses them. A guard on these doors would refuse the undo of an ADR-0131 D6 customization, a narrowing beyond the card. The seat chose not to add it; the overlay revert is pinned as a control.

**BREAKING** (patch, ruling A #25105: a non-protocol narrowing ships `patch`):

- FROM: `POST /packages/B/commits/COMMIT_OF_A/revert` answered 200, reverted A's items and recorded a revert commit in A's history. TO: `404 COMMIT_NOT_FOUND`, nothing written.
- FROM: `POST /packages/B/rollback` `{ commitId: COMMIT_OF_A }` answered 200 and reverted A's newer commits. TO: `404 COMMIT_NOT_FOUND`, nothing written.
- FROM: either door with an unknown or uninstalled `:id` acted on the commit. TO: `404 Package 'ID' not found`.

## Tests

- **Dogfood, new `package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts` (7 cases, showcase boot, REST):** cross-package revert 404 and A's history and items unchanged; cross-package rollback 404, both histories and A's items unchanged; unknown package 404 on both doors; member without `manage_metadata` 403 on both; controls: own-path revert (200, `revertedCount: 1`, revert commit recorded, item removed) and own-path rollback (200, the newer commit reverted); a read-only package's overlay commit: 404 through another package's path with the showcase history unchanged, 200 through its own path removing the overlay.
- **Runtime unit, new `packages-commit-door-path-package.test.ts` (6 cases):** each door hands the protocol `{ commitId, packageId }`, relays the protocol's `COMMIT_NOT_FOUND` as 404, and answers an unknown package 404 without calling the protocol.
- **Protocol unit, `packages/objectql/src/protocol-commit-history.test.ts` (+2 cases):** `revertCommit` and `rollbackToPackageCommit` with another package's id reject `COMMIT_NOT_FOUND`/404 with the message, with no delete, no restore and no new commit row; the same call with the commit's own package reverts.

<details><summary>Red on main, green on head, ablation</summary>

- Red on main `ab085a04` (dogfood file, `dist/` built from main): `3 failed | 4 passed (7)`. Cross-package revert: 200 `{"revertedCount":1,"reverted":[{"type":"object","name":"cmtpa_second","action":"removed"}],"revertCommitId":"cmt_…"}`. Cross-package rollback: 200 `{"revertedCommits":["cmt_…"],"failed":[]}`. Unknown package: 200 (`revertedCount: 1`). The controls passed on main.
- Read-only probe on main (same boot): overlay draft save 200 (`Saved customization overlay (env-wide, package=com.example.showcase, state=draft)`), `publish-drafts` 200 `outcome: published` with a `commitId`, `GET /packages/com.example.showcase/commits` lists that `apply` commit, its revert 200 `reverted: [{ type: view, name: showcase_task.default, action: removed }]`.
- Green on head `a4647aa1`: dogfood file `7 passed (7)`; `@objectstack/runtime` `pnpm test`: `514 passed` files, `8273 passed | 19 skipped` tests; objectql `protocol-commit-history.test.ts` `32 passed (32)`.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `readRevertableCommit`: the condition becomes `packageId === '__ablated_pkg_check__' && …`, so it never matches; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 2 built files): dogfood `3 failed | 4 passed (7)`, exactly the cross-package revert, the cross-package rollback and the overlay case at its cross-package step (expected 404, received 200); the unknown-package case (runtime check) and every own-path control stayed green. objectql `2 failed | 30 passed (32)`, the two new mismatch cases only. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` clean. A first attempt used `if (false && …)` as the mutation; the bundler folded it away, the dist preflight answered "marker ABSENT", and that run's reading was discarded.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **An uninstalled package.** The card's repro reverted A's commit after A was uninstalled. With the ruling's unknown-package 404, an uninstalled package's commit is now refused through its own path too (404 `Package 'ID' not found`); `GET /packages/:id/commits` still serves a trail that outlived its package.
- **In-process callers** of `revertCommit` / `rollbackToPackageCommit` (no non-REST caller exists in the repo besides the rollback's own inner `revertCommit` steps, which read commits listed under the target's package) keep reading any commit when they send no `packageId`.
- **Clause-② arm.** The seat's correction said a narrowing-only change is `no (narrowing)`. This diff also adds an optional member to two published `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` method requests, which is the widening the order names, so the line is `yes (narrowing)`.
- Overlap: of the 49 open PRs, four touch `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (#29066, #29003, #28850, #28731) and none touch `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`; no hunk of theirs is in `readRevertableCommit`, `revertCommit` or `rollbackToPackageCommit` (#28850's rollback hunks are in `rollbackMetaItem`).

## Verification

Every local reading above is on head `a4647aa1`. `pnpm typecheck` for `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/runtime` (with `check:test-typecheck`), `@objectstack/objectql` (with `check:test-typecheck`) and `@objectstack/dogfood`: exit 0. Derived gate families (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 67 derived; at the time of writing 63 had run, 61 with exit 0; `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` answered exit 3 on the shallow clone and exit 0 (48 cases) after `git fetch --depth=1` of its fixture commit; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, NOT MEASURED (its prerequisite, every package's `dist/`, is not met in this checkout); `check:type-check-debt`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:watch-hint-literal` and `check:where-matcher` were still running when the maintainer's pause arrived and are NOT MEASURED here. `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: exit 0, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. Full dogfood battery (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm): started on this head under the verify lock, still running at the pause; NOT MEASURED here, the reading goes to the seat. The repo-wide lint, `test:repo` and the full farm are CI's.
